messages:
Priya M.: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: release cadence, oncall, and SLAs. Want a concise action list so teams can proceed.
Sam H.: Summary: prefer 3-week planning as default to reduce mid-sprint scope churn; teams can remain at 2 or 4 weeks if they document trade-offs. Goal = predictable windows for coordination.
Mei Z.: If teams change cadence, how does that affect oncall handovers?
Sam H.: Change: primary oncall moves to 7-day rotations (Mon-Sun) to cut duplicate handoffs. Night/holiday secondary coverage unchanged. Fewer handovers per quarter.
Aria L.: Any SLA or paging changes we should tell responders about?
Sam H.: Paging unchanged: sev1 pages immediate, ack target 15m, mitigation plan 30m. New runbook checkboxes will map actions to those times.
Jules K.: How strict are the rollout quality gates?
Sam H.: Every model rollout needs a prerelease eval harness + no-regression checks on embeddings similarity and content safety. Canary required with automated monitoring.
Ken P.: What latency commitments for Dedicated customers?
Sam H.: Baseline Dedicated gen profile: p95 <= 250ms. Long-context or special-model profiles documented per-model (e.g., 64k context p95 <= 700ms).
Priya M.: Can someone paste the canary template we agreed to?
Mei Z.: Paste from notes: {"canary_percent":5, "stages":[5,25,100], "health_metrics":["p95_latency","error_rate","quality_regressions"], "auto_promote_on":"all_checks_green"}
Aria L.: CI auto-promote behavior?
Sam H.: CI will auto-promote after 2 consecutive green checks and 30m of no new errors. Ops can abort via deploy dashboard.
Jules K.: Who owns runbook and post-release checklist updates?
Jules K.: I will update runbooks. Aria will publish the post-release checklist and eval prompt sets.
Ken P.: I'll draft the customer-facing SLA blurb and update status pages.
ops-bot: deploy started for release/infra-2026-05 at 2161112350 :rocket:
Priya M.: Action items recap: Sam land template in infra repo; Jules refresh runbooks; Aria publish eval harness; Ken draft SLA copy. Drop PRs into #eng-process.
Sam H.: Will follow up with PR link once landed.
Priya M.: Thanks all ":white_check_mark:"
